title: Kevin Feige Says Ryan Coogler Met With David Jonsson Six Months Ago in a ‘Secret Meeting’ to Discuss ‘Black Panther 3’ Role: ‘I Got Chills’
content:
ByJack Dunn

Marvelboss Kevin Feige recently toldEmpirehowDavid Jonssonwas cast as the next Black Panther. He explained that “The Long Walk” star met with “Black Panther” directorRyan Cooglerin a “secret meeting,” and that the Oscar winner quickly identified Jonsson as his next leading man.

“We hadn’t started a search yet,” Feige explained. “Ryan was working on ‘Sinners,’ and when Ryan works on a project he’s all in. So the presumption very much was we would sit with him after ‘Sinners’ came out, after the Academy campaign. We were waiting ’til after the Academy Awards to sit with Ryan and begin that process.”

He added, “A month and a half or so before that process, he called me and said, ‘I found him’. I said, ‘What do you mean?’ He goes, ‘I found him. He’s this guy, David Jonsson.’ He mentioned his movies. I had seen some of them. I watched more. He goes, ‘I’m going to meet him.’ He had a secret meeting with him under cloak of darkness in a hotel somewhere, and called me afterwards and said, ‘He’s the guy, he’s the guy, I felt it. I felt it in my soul. He’s a good man, and he is the next Black Panther.’ And I got chills, and I got a little welled-up and said, ‘Let’s do it’. So we’ve been sitting on this secret for a good five or six months.”

Jonsson will play T’Challa’s son in “Black Panther 3,” which hits theaters Dec. 15, 2028. The announcement was made duringMarvel’s Hall H panelon Saturday at San Diego Comic-Con. Original cast members Leticia Wright and Winston Duke are returning for the new chapter, which follows Prince T’Challa II as he comes of age and takes up the Black Panther mantle.

After Chadwick Bosemandied of colon cancer at age 43 in 2020, Wright was the first to take over as the Black Panther in 2022’s “Wakanda Forever.”

Marvel launched the first “Black Panther” in 2018 to overwhelming acclaim. It grossed $1.3 billion at the worldwide box office and earned seven Oscar nominations, including best picture.
title_zh: 凱文·費吉(Kevin Feige)表示，瑞安·庫格勒(Ryan Coogler)六個月前與大衛·瓊森(David Jonsson)進行了一次“秘密會議”，討論《黑豹3》(Black Panther 3)的角色。他說：“我感到一陣寒意。”
content_zh:
由Jack Dunn報導

漫威總裁凱文·費吉(Kevin Feige)最近告訴《帝國雜誌》(Empire)，大衛·喬恩森(David Jonsson)是如何被選為下一任黑豹的。他解釋道，這位《漫長的散步》(The Long Walk)的明星與《黑豹》(Black Panther)導演瑞安·庫格勒(Ryan Coogler)進行了一次“秘密會議”，而這位奧斯卡獲獎者迅速認定喬恩森是他的下一位男主角。

“我們還沒有開始尋找，”費吉解釋道。“瑞安正在製作《罪人》(Sinners)，當瑞安在進行一個項目時，他會全心投入。因此，當時的假設是我們會在《罪人》上映後，學院獎競選結束後再與他會面。我們在等待學院獎結束後再與瑞安坐下來開始這個過程。”

他補充道：“大約在這個過程開始的前一個半月，他打電話給我說，‘我找到了他。’我問，‘你是什麼意思？’他說，‘我找到了他。他就是這個人，大衛·喬恩森。’他提到了一些他的電影。我看過其中的一些，還看了更多。他說，‘我要去見他。’他在某個酒店裡與他進行了一次秘密會議，然後打電話告訴我，‘他就是那個人，他就是那個人，我感覺到了。我在靈魂深處感覺到了。他是一個好人，他就是下一任黑豹。’我感到一陣寒意，眼眶有些濕潤，說，‘那就這樣吧。’所以我們已經秘密保持了這個消息五六個月。”

喬恩森將在《黑豹3》(Black Panther 3)中飾演查拉王子(T’Challa)的兒子，該片將於2028年12月15日上映。這一消息是在漫威於聖地亞哥動漫展的H廳小組會議上宣布的。原班演員萊蒂西亞·賴特(Leticia Wright)和溫斯頓·杜克(Winston Duke)將回歸新篇章，故事講述查拉二世王子成長並承擔黑豹的使命。

在查德維克·博斯曼(Chadwick Boseman)於2020年因結腸癌去世，享年43歲後，賴特成為2022年《瓦坎達萬歲》(Wakanda Forever)中首位接替黑豹的人。

漫威於2018年推出的首部《黑豹》獲得了壓倒性的好評。該片在全球票房收入達到13億美元，並獲得七項奧斯卡提名，包括最佳影片。
